problem_trigger: Issue #128 tested whether accumulated evidence could be converted into a compact real-user decision product rather than continuing evidence accumulation. DP0001 required a bounded MODIFY cycle before independent C PASS and integration; post-integration evaluation supported KEEP as an internal prototype while finding external revealed usefulness untested.
prior_design: The portfolio favored synthesis and decision usefulness but had not yet tested a concrete compact decision product through producer handoff, independent product review, bounded correction, integration, and post-integration disposition.
hypothesis_rationale: A compact decision product with explicit present-vs-contingent routing, self-contained provenance, cannot-compare states, and lifecycle metadata may make canonical evidence more decision-useful than another research brief. A bounded MODIFY cycle should reveal whether defects are correctable without expanding into platform work.
exact_change: Within ordinary management authority, D routed issue #128 through one prototype (DP0001), independent C review, a bounded MODIFY correction, exact-head CI/C re-review, integration through PR #150, and post-integration disposition. D then classified the product concept KEEP as a validated internal prototype but held DP0002 and platform/UI/API expansion because external usefulness remains unvalidated. No outreach was conducted and no scheduler, permission, governance, security, licensing, constitutional, or agent-authority boundary changed.
expected_benefit: Test whether synthesis can terminate in a concrete decision artifact rather than more evidence accumulation.
Expose product-level defects through independent review before repetition.
Create a reusable reference prototype for future usefulness testing without committing to a platform.
Use explicit stop/modify/keep disposition to prevent artifact proliferation.
risks: Internal reviewers can mistake structural quality for real external usefulness.
A successful correction cycle can create pressure to generate DP0002 without incremental value of information.
Productization can become schema/UI ceremony rather than improving decisions.
External validation may require outreach and therefore human review under existing policy.
evaluation_window: Internal prototype cycle completed; external usefulness remains unresolved until a policy-compliant real-user or blinded comparative test is authorized and completed.
evaluation_criteria: Independent review can identify decision-relevant defects and bounded correction resolves them.
Integrated product preserves provenance, uncertainty, present-vs-contingent routing, and cannot-compare states.
Post-integration evaluation distinguishes internal validity from external revealed usefulness.
No second product or platform expansion is started without explicit incremental VOI.
If external testing is later authorized, measure decision accuracy/appropriateness, time-to-decision, comprehension, and preference versus ordinary evidence synthesis using falsifiable criteria.

observed_outcomes.observation: DP0001 required a bounded MODIFY cycle to clarify present versus contingent routing, compact provenance, and lifecycle behavior before final independent C PASS and integration through PR #150.
Post-MODIFY evaluation recommended KEEP for the internal prototype while explicitly finding external revealed usefulness untested.
D held DP0002 and platform/UI/API expansion after integration rather than treating one internally successful prototype as evidence for repetition.

The prototype demonstrates that canonical evidence can be transformed into a reviewable decision artifact, but it does not yet demonstrate that the artifact improves real external decisions relative to ordinary synthesis.

failures_side_effects: The product cycle incurred duplicate-handoff/controller toil captured separately in DH0005.
Internal validation cannot answer the highest-VOI remaining question of external decision usefulness.
The productization checkpoint became overdue after the KEEP disposition and therefore correctly held new Tier-2 production until recorded.
lessons: Keep internal product validity and external usefulness as separate claims.
Do not produce DP0002 merely to demonstrate repeatability; require incremental VOI over testing the existing prototype.
Prefer bounded MODIFY over platform expansion when a prototype has correctable decision-routing defects.
External-use testing that requires outreach remains human-review gated; read-only test design does not authorize contact.
